message: a model produced a non-finite value (NaN or inf) in the equation of {unknown}
description: A model's contribution to this unknown's equation is not a number at the current trial point, so the solve stopped before the linear solve. The equations are not singular: a contribution divides by zero, or takes the log, square root or power of a value outside its domain. On Newton's first iteration every probe reads 0.0, which is the usual way to get there.
actions: Look at the device(s) contributing to this unknown.
Guard such a probe in the model, e.g. `(x > 0.0) ? x : x_default`, or start from a better point with `.nodeset`.
